Engine is the decision maker

Pages and actions are thin. lib/engine.ts decides research,
enrollment, drafting, sending and when to stop on a reply.
The email, LinkedIn and refresh views have the details.
Source: lib/engine.ts
Owner-only gate

Pages call requireOwner(); every server action runs through
run() → assertOwner(), allowlisted to OWNER_EMAIL.
Source: app/(app)/actions.ts

Home route required

Before each run the worker checks that Tailscale reports the exit node online and that the
proxy IP differs from Fly's. Otherwise the run waits, up to a 24h TTL.
Source: browser/worker.py
Async confirm
The app polls up to 75s; unfinished runs stay 'sending' and refresh() resolves them later.
Source: lib/engine.ts, lib/linkedin.ts

Bounded under 300s

The cron route has maxDuration 300 and gives fillPipeline a 230s deadline. A failed check is
recorded as a health problem and refresh keeps going.
Source: app/api/cron/route.ts, lib/engine.ts
Never sends

refresh confirms LinkedIn runs, detects replies, drafts due steps and fills the CRM; it does
not enroll or send.
Source: lib/engine.ts

Scraped text is untrusted

Website/HN/YC/LinkedIn text is fenced in <untrusted> tags for the model; website fetches
pass an SSRF guard.
